matter.title: Asset purchase agreement vs closing checklist
matter.instruction: Compare the attached APA against the closing checklist and produce a categorized, severity-rated deviation report.

runs.note: Criteria passed on the benchmark's official rubric, graded by two AI judges. One run each.

documents.note: Counsel's working summary of the agreement. This is the document being checked.

path.step: Took the report's statements one by one
path.detail: 23 statements: 12 deviations and 11 terms the report says are consistent.

path.step: Found the passage behind each statement in both documents
path.detail: For a defined term, the definition itself rather than a clause that happens to repeat the figure.

path.step: Recomputed every figure that can be recomputed
path.detail: Percentages of the purchase price, the closing payment, the monthly fees.

path.step: Proved the statements that had no citation
path.detail: The report cited nothing for 12 statements, including all 11 it calls consistent. Each now has both passages.

path.step: Read the agreement's closing deliverables against the checklist
path.detail: Sections 8.1 and 8.2, item by item, looking for anything the checklist leaves out.

path.step: Searched the checklist for each item that seemed to be missing
path.detail: An omission cannot be quoted, so it is shown by a search that returns nothing.

path.step: Checked every quote against the documents a second time, by program
path.detail: A separate checker opens the files and confirms each quote is really there.

claims.text: The agreement is inconsistent on the Buyer's identity: the cover page and signature block name Vanguard Industrial Holdings, Inc., while the preamble and operative provisions name Saxonbrook Industrial Holdings, Inc., and the Buyer's notice email uses the domain vanguardindustrial.com.

sources.locator: Cover page
sources.quote: VANGUARD INDUSTRIAL HOLDINGS, INC.

sources.locator: Signature block
sources.quote: BUYER: ... VANGUARD INDUSTRIAL HOLDINGS, INC. ... Name: Marcus Ellsworth

sources.locator: Preamble
sources.quote: by and between Saxonbrook Industrial Holdings, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Buyer")

sources.locator: § 11.1, notices
sources.quote: Email: dhu@vanguardindustrial.com

sources.locator: Title block
sources.quote: Saxonbrook Industrial Holdings, Inc. ("Buyer")

claims.check: Found both names in the agreement itself. The running page header also says Vanguard.

claims.text: Escrow Amount: the checklist states $5,500,000; the agreement defines it as $5,250,000.

sources.locator: Part I, summary of key deal terms
sources.quote: Escrow Amount: $5,500,000 (five million five hundred thousand dollars), representing approximately 6% of the Purchase Price

sources.locator: Art. I, definition of Escrow Amount
sources.quote: "Escrow Amount" means Five Million Two Hundred Fifty Thousand Dollars ($5,250,000), representing six percent (6%) of the Purchase Price

claims.check: Found both figures. 6% of $87,500,000 is $5,250,000, so the agreement's figure is the one that matches its own percentage.
claims.note: The original report cited the definition of Closing Cash Payment for this figure. The defining clause is the definition of Escrow Amount, shown here.

claims.text: Closing Cash Payment: the checklist states $78,500,000; the agreement states $78,750,000.

sources.locator: Part I, summary of key deal terms
sources.quote: Closing Cash Payment: $78,500,000 (seventy-eight million five hundred thousand dollars)

sources.locator: Art. I, definition of Closing Cash Payment
sources.quote: "Closing Cash Payment" means an amount equal to Seventy-Eight Million Seven Hundred Fifty Thousand Dollars ($78,750,000)

claims.check: Recomputed both. Purchase price less escrow less holdback gives $78,750,000 with the agreement's escrow and $78,500,000 with the checklist's, so this error follows from the escrow error.

claims.text: Holdback Amount: the checklist says it is 5% of the Purchase Price; the agreement says 4%.

sources.locator: Part I, summary of key deal terms
sources.quote: Holdback Amount: $3,500,000 (three million five hundred thousand dollars), representing 5% of the Purchase Price

sources.locator: Art. I, definition of Holdback Amount
sources.quote: "Holdback Amount" means Three Million Five Hundred Thousand Dollars ($3,500,000), representing four percent (4%) of the Purchase Price

claims.check: Found both. $3,500,000 is 4% of $87,500,000, so the dollar amount agrees and only the checklist's percentage is wrong.

claims.text: General Indemnification Cap: the checklist states $8,500,000; the agreement states $8,750,000 (10% of the Purchase Price).

sources.locator: Part I, summary of key deal terms
sources.quote: Seller's General Indemnification Cap: $8,500,000 (eight million five hundred thousand dollars), representing approximately 10% of the Purchase Price

sources.locator: Art. I, definition of General Indemnification Cap
sources.quote: "General Indemnification Cap" means Eight Million Seven Hundred Fifty Thousand Dollars ($8,750,000), which amount represents ten percent (10%) of the Purchase Price

claims.text: Escrow Period: the checklist states 24 months (release around May 15, 2027); the agreement defines it as 18 months, expiring November 15, 2026.

sources.locator: Part I, summary of key deal terms
sources.quote: Escrow Period: Twenty-four (24) months following the Closing Date

sources.locator: Part VI, item PC-3
sources.quote: Escrow Release ... ~May 15, 2027

sources.locator: Art. I, definition of Escrow Period
sources.quote: "Escrow Period" means the period of eighteen (18) months following the Closing Date. If the Closing occurs on May 15, 2025, the Escrow Period shall expire on November 15, 2026.

claims.check: Found all three passages word for word.

claims.text: De Minimis Collar: the agreement sets a $150,000 threshold below which no working capital adjustment is made; the checklist's description of the adjustment omits it.

sources.locator: Art. I, definition of De Minimis Collar
sources.quote: "De Minimis Collar" means One Hundred Fifty Thousand Dollars ($150,000), as described in Section 2.6(d)

sources.locator: Part I, summary of key deal terms
sources.quote: Working Capital Adjustment: Dollar-for-dollar adjustment for any deviation from the Target Net Working Capital of $6,800,000.

claims.check: Found the collar in the agreement, then searched the whole checklist for it. It is not there.

claims.text: Transition services fee: the checklist states $50,000 per month ($300,000 total); the agreement states $45,000 per month ($270,000 in aggregate).

sources.locator: Part IV, item S-4
sources.quote: The monthly fee for transition services shall be $50,000 per month for a total of $300,000 over the six-month term.
at a fee of Forty-Five Thousand Dollars ($45,000) per month (for an aggregate fee of Two Hundred Seventy Thousand Dollars ($270,000))

claims.check: Found both. Six months at each rate gives $300,000 and $270,000.

claims.text: Non-competition term: the checklist states 3 years; the agreement states 4 years.

sources.locator: Part IV, item S-5
sources.quote: The Non-Competition Agreement shall have a term of three (3) years from the Closing Date
providing for a non-competition period of four (4) years following the Closing Date

claims.check: Found both passages word for word.

claims.text: Outside Date: the checklist states July 14, 2025 and cites Section 9.1(b); the agreement defines it as August 14, 2025 under Section 10.1(b).

sources.locator: Part I, summary of key deal terms
sources.quote: Outside Date: July 14, 2025. If the Closing has not occurred by the Outside Date, either party may terminate the APA in accordance with Section 9.1(b)

sources.locator: Art. I, definition of Outside Date
sources.quote: "Outside Date" means August 14, 2025, as described in Section 10.1(b).

claims.check: Found both passages word for word.

claims.text: Good Standing Certificates: the checklist lists only Oregon; the agreement requires certificates from Oregon and Washington.

sources.locator: Part IV, item S-7
sources.quote: Certificate of Good Standing (or Certificate of Existence) for Cascade Precision Components, LLC issued by the Oregon Secretary of State.
of the State of Oregon and the State of Washington

claims.check: Found both passages, then searched the checklist for Washington. It does not appear anywhere.

claims.text: Cross-reference errors: the checklist cites Article IX provisions where Article X (Termination) provisions are meant.

sources.locator: Part I, summary of key deal terms
sources.quote: terminate the APA in accordance with Section 9.1(b)
the right to terminate this Agreement under this Section 10.1(b)

sources.locator: Part I, summary of key deal terms
sources.quote: to secure Seller's indemnification obligations under Article X of the APA

sources.locator: Article headings
sources.quote: ARTICLE IX — INDEMNIFICATION

sources.locator: Article headings
sources.quote: ARTICLE X — TERMINATION

claims.check: True as stated, and it also runs the other way: the checklist cites indemnification as Article X in three places, where the agreement's indemnification article is Article IX.
claims.note: The original report gave no citation for this statement.

claims.text: Reverse Break-Up Fee ($2,625,000) is consistent.

sources.locator: Part I, summary of key deal terms
sources.quote: Reverse Break-Up Fee: $2,625,000 (two million six hundred twenty-five thousand dollars), representing 3% of the Purchase Price, payable by Buyer to Seller in the event of termination by Seller pursuant to Section 9.1(d) of the APA.

sources.locator: Art. I, definition of Reverse Break-Up Fee
sources.quote: "Reverse Break-Up Fee" means Two Million Six Hundred Twenty-Five Thousand Dollars ($2,625,000), representing three percent (3%) of the Purchase Price
In the event this Agreement is terminated by Seller pursuant to Section 10.1(e)

claims.check: The amount is the same in both documents. The trigger is not: the checklist points to Section 9.1(d), the agreement to Section 10.1(e).

claims.text: Accrued PTO (about $387,000) is consistent.

sources.locator: Part I, summary of key deal terms
sources.quote: Accrued PTO Liability (Assumed): Estimated at approximately $387,000 as of the anticipated Closing Date.
estimated at approximately Three Hundred Eighty-Seven Thousand Dollars ($387,000) as of the date hereof, which amount shall be adjusted to reflect the actual accrued balances as of the Closing Date

claims.check: The amount is the same. The reference date is not: the checklist gives the estimate as of the anticipated Closing Date, the agreement as of its signing date, to be adjusted at Closing.

diff: as of the anticipated Closing Date

claims.text: The employee offer threshold is consistent.

sources.locator: Part I, summary of key deal terms
sources.quote: Employee Matters: Buyer shall offer employment to at least 85% of Seller's 127 full-time employees (i.e., at least 108 employees)
offer employment to at least eighty-five percent (85%) of Seller's one hundred twenty-seven (127) full-time employees

claims.check: Found the same threshold in both documents. 85% of 127 is 107.95, which rounds up to the 108 both documents state.
